blocks.explanation:
\(e^{\tan^{-1}x}\) dekh kar \(t = \tan^{-1}x\) rakhna sab se behtar hai, yani \(x = \tan t\).
Phir \(dx = \sec^2 t\,dt\) aur \(1 + x^2 = \sec^2 t\); denominator \(\sec^4 t\) ban jata hai aur integral \(\int e^t\cos^2 t\,dt\) reh jata hai.
\(\cos^2 t\) ki power ghatane ke liye \(\frac{1 + \cos 2t}{2}\) likhenge.
\(\int e^t\cos 2t\,dt\) Example 35 ki tarah do dafa parts se aayega (integral wapas aata hai).
Aakhir mein \(\cos 2t\) aur \(\sin 2t\) ko \(x\) mein badalna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{e^{\tan^{-1}x}}{(1 + x^2)^2}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: \(t = \tan^{-1}x\); \(\int e^t\cos^2 t\,dt\) banayenge, \(\cos^2 t = \frac{1 + \cos 2t}{2}\), aur \(\int e^t\cos 2t\,dt\) do dafa parts se.

\(t = \tan^{-1}x\) rakhein
\[x = \tan t,\ dx = \sec^2 t\,dt\]
\[(1 + x^2)^2 = \sec^4 t\]
\[= \int \dfrac{e^t\sec^2 t}{\sec^4 t}\,dt = \int e^t\cos^2 t\,dt\]
Kyun: \(1 + \tan^2 t = \sec^2 t\); \(\sec^2 t\) upar aur \(\sec^4 t\) neeche, to \(\frac{1}{\sec^2 t} = \cos^2 t\) bacha.

Power ghatayein
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\int e^t\,dt + \dfrac{1}{2}\int e^t\cos 2t\,dt\]
\[= \dfrac{e^t}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2}J\]
Kyun: \(\cos^2 t = \frac{1 + \cos 2t}{2}\). Mushkil hissay ko \(J\) ka naam diya taa ke alag se nikaal sakein.

\(J\) do dafa parts se
\[J = e^t\cos 2t + 2\int e^t\sin 2t\,dt\]
\[\int e^t\sin 2t\,dt = e^t\sin 2t - 2J\]
\[J = e^t\cos 2t + 2e^t\sin 2t - 4J\]
Kyun: dono dafa trigonometric function first aur \(e^t\) second (ek hi choice, warna kaam ulat jata hai). \(J\) wapas aa gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 2t\) ka derivative \(-2\sin 2t\) hai; 2 ka factor bhoolne se \(J\) ka coefficient ghalat ho jata hai.

\(J\) solve karein
\[5J = e^t(\cos 2t + 2\sin 2t)\]
\[J = \dfrac{e^t}{5}(\cos 2t + 2\sin 2t)\]
Kyun: \(-4J\) ko left par laye: \(J + 4J = 5J\).

Wapas \(x\) mein
\[\cos 2t = \dfrac{1 - x^2}{1 + x^2},\ \sin 2t = \dfrac{2x}{1 + x^2}\]
\[I = \dfrac{e^t}{2} + \dfrac{e^t(1 - x^2 + 4x)}{10(1 + x^2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{e^t[5(1 + x^2) + 1 - x^2 + 4x]}{10(1 + x^2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{\tan^{-1}x}(2x^2 + 2x + 3)}{5(1 + x^2)} + c\]
Kyun: double angle ke \(\tan\) wale formulas: \(\cos 2t = \frac{1 - \tan^2 t}{1 + \tan^2 t}\), \(\sin 2t = \frac{2\tan t}{1 + \tan^2 t}\), aur \(\tan t = x\). Common denominator le kar numerator \(4x^2 + 4x + 6\) bana; 2 cancel kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\dfrac{e^{\tan^{-1}x}(2x^2 + 2x + 3)}{5(1 + x^2)}\right] = \dfrac{e^{\tan^{-1}x}}{(1 + x^2)^2}\]
Kyun: jawab ko differentiate kar ke sympy se check kiya; integrand wapas milta hai.
